The speaker delivered a __profound__ speech that left the audience deeply moved.
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"profound"** means something that is very deep, intense, or having great insight or understanding. (गंभीर)

 
 
• **Example: **The philosopher gave a*** profound*** analysis of human existence.
 
 
 
• **"Shallow" **refers to something that is not deep, either physically or metaphorically; lacking depth of intellect, emotion, or knowledge. (उथला)
 
 
• **Example: **His arguments were*** shallow ***and didn't convince anyone.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'profound' **is **'shallow'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deep **(गहरा): Extending far down from the top or surface; profound.

 
 
• **Example:** The lake is very **deep** and perfect for diving.
 
 
 
• **Inventive **(अविष्कारशील): Having the ability to create or design new things or to think originally.
 
 
• **Example: **Her** inventive** mind always comes up with unique solutions.
 
 
 
• **Occult** (गुप्त): Relating to mystical, supernatural, or magical powers, practices, or phenomena.
 
 
• **Example:** He delved into the **occult** to find answers to his questions.
